import pytest
from your_module import title_case  # Replace `your_module` with the actual module name.


class TestTitleCase:
    # --- Happy path and edge cases ---
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "input_str, expected",
        [
            # Happy path
            ("hello world", "Hello World"),
            ("HELLO WORLD", "Hello World"),
            ("python", "Python"),
            ("a", "A"),
            ("A", "A"),
            ("café au lait", "Café Au Lait"),
            ("123 abc", "123 Abc"),
            ("hello, world!", "Hello, World!"),
            # Edge cases
            ("", ""),                          # empty string
            ("   ", ""),                       # only whitespace
            ("  hello   world  ", "Hello World"),  # leading/trailing/extra spaces
            ("hello\tworld", "Hello World"),   # tabs
            ("new\nline", "New Line"),         # newlines
            ("multiple   spaces", "Multiple Spaces"),
        ],
    )
    def test_title_case(self, input_str: str, expected: str) -> None:
        assert title_case(input_str) == expected

    # --- Error cases ---
    def test_title_case_type_error_none(self) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            title_case(None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def test_title_case_type_error_int(self) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            title_case(123)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def test_title_case_type_error_list(self) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            title_case(["hello", "world"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
